name: paga-justo
description: PagaJusto - AI Escrow for Freelancers on Stellar

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --success first "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm --prefix packages/shared test && npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix packages/shared ci && npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
